summary: Fix Status::Update to retain the first error.
explanation: In Status.Update, s starts OK and s.Update(a) should store a, the CANCELLED status with message "message". After s.Update(b), the assertion at line 515 expects s == a, but observed s is INTERNAL: other message: the const overload overwrites an existing error with every later error. After s.Update(OkStatus()), line 517 expects s == a and line 518 expects s.ok() to be false, but observed s is OK and s.ok() is true: the rvalue overload assigns when its argument is OK. Both overloads must update only when the receiver is OK and the new status is non-OK.
